title: Can We Boost The Immune System?

blanks.sentence: The immune system works as the body’s _____ against illness.
Oranges are often chosen because people link them with _____.
In winter, some people take _____ to strengthen their body’s protection.
Another common method is _____, although the programme questions how useful it is.
A nasal product was judged no more effective than _____.
A popular UK health trend mentioned in the programme is _____.
People who do this activity say it benefits their _____.
Stress may matter because _____ can make the immune system weaker.
A stressed person may become more likely to suffer from _____.
The same possible benefit might also come from social activities such as _____.

multipleChoice.question: What is the programme mainly going to examine at the start?
options: Why winter illnesses have become more serious
Whether common immune-boosting habits really help
How vitamin C was first discovered
Which foods contain the most vitamins

multipleChoice.question: Which group of illnesses is used to show why winter health is a concern?
options: Allergies, asthma and headaches
Food poisoning and stomach problems
Skin infections and tiredness
Colds, flu and Covid-19

multipleChoice.question: What is Margaret McCartney’s view of the nasal product mentioned?
options: It may be interesting, but it is not better than salt-water spray
It is clearly the best way to prevent winter illness
It works only if people also take vitamins
It is dangerous and should not be used

multipleChoice.question: What broader point is made about many popular health products?
options: They are useful only for older adults
They work better when combined with exercise
There is not enough proof that they affect immune function
They are effective because many people buy them

multipleChoice.question: What do cold-water swimmers believe about the activity in winter?
options: It may reduce their chance of becoming ill
It completely prevents colds
It replaces the need for medical treatment
It only helps competitive athletes

multipleChoice.question: Why might being with other people help the immune system indirectly?
options: It exposes people to more germs safely
It makes cold water less dangerous
It increases the amount of vitamin C in the body
It can reduce stress, which may otherwise weaken immunity

multipleChoice.question: What can be inferred about stress from John’s explanation?
options: Stress has no connection with illness
Stress may make someone more vulnerable to infection
Stress only affects people who swim in cold water
Stress is always caused by being alone

multipleChoice.question: How does John limit his support for cold-water swimming?
options: He says it is harmful for most people
He says it is useful only in winter
He says similar benefits may come from other activities
He says it works only with medical supervision

multipleChoice.question: In the explanation, what does “dampens” mean when used about the immune system?
options: Makes it weaker
Makes it quicker
Makes it more accurate
Makes it disappear

multipleChoice.question: What is the final cautious conclusion about cold-water swimming?
options: Only cold-water swimming can improve winter health
It may help through stress reduction, but other activities may do the same
It has been proven to stop all winter colds
It works mainly because cold water kills viruses
